newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Kabila finance minister under house arrest-radio.
newsitem.headline: Kabila finance minister under house arrest-radio.

text.p: Laurent Kabila's finance minister, Mawampanga Mwana Nanga, has been placed under house arrest, state radio reported on Thursday.
Government sources linked the move to an investigation into money transfers.
One source said the government was to hold an emergency meeting on the case. "The president is away. We will wait until he comes back home to hold this meeting," he added.
Kabila on Wednesday went to Eritrea.
Another source said that Economy Minister Pierre Victor Mpoyo was acting as finance minister.

Mawampanga is widely seen as one of the members of Kabila's government supporting a free-market approach to the economy. Other ministers have called for varying degrees of government intervention in different sectors.
